historical_result_policy: The complete v5 matrix remains immutable provenance. The v6 matrix re-executes only altruistic cells after the 50% baseline-revenue retention correction and is not pooled with v5 altruistic outcomes.
change_reason: replace unconstrained PTO-cost minimization, whose trivial tariff optimum is minimum buy and maximum sell multipliers, with a cooperative pricing problem subject to a 50% baseline-revenue retention floor
freeze the full-day aggregator revenue reference and its 50% retained floor before any real-time disturbance
allow each real-time decision to influence only the remaining revenue requirement after causal settlement
rank altruistic candidates by operational-priority satisfaction, baseline-revenue retention compliance, and then lower projected full-day PTO cost
remove battery-throughput proxy from the paper-facing secondary contrasts because repeated cycling is not a material opportunity in these bus schedules

design.analysis: descriptive difference in repeated-episode means within each case-mode cell; v5 altruistic outcomes are historical and excluded

contrasts.name: llm_trigger_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Replace only the LLM Trigger interpreter with the frozen text parser.

contrasts.name: llm_pricing_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Replace only LLM pricing with the deterministic price-zone heuristic under the same 50% baseline-revenue retention policy.

contrasts.name: llm_evaluator_contribution
contrasts.single_component_changed: Remove only the LLM evaluator while retaining solver, feasibility, and method-independent baseline-revenue retention guards.

controls.causal_interval_settlement: settle interval t before the decision and optimize t+1 through 48

altruistic_baseline_revenue_retention.baseline_source: frozen day_ahead_summary.aggregator_revenue for the altruistic mode
altruistic_baseline_revenue_retention.full_day_rule: projected full-day aggregator revenue must be at least the frozen floor
altruistic_baseline_revenue_retention.remaining_rule: remaining revenue required equals max(0, frozen full-day floor minus realized settled-prefix revenue)
candidate_order: evaluator acceptance only as an objective tie-breaker
altruistic_baseline_revenue_retention.rerun_cap_policy: if no candidate meets the floor, retain the usable candidate with the smallest shortfall and flag it noncompliant

controls.candidate_selection: operational priority first; for altruistic candidates require the 50% baseline-revenue retention floor before comparing projected full-day PTO cost
controls.feedback_compliance_guard: enforce only the Evaluator's explicit structured side, direction, executable window, and target when a rerun array is numerically noncompliant

outcomes.altruistic_score: among runs meeting the 50% baseline-revenue retention floor, negative realized full-day PTO cost; higher is better
